map.热应激指数(THI)预警器: Heat stress index (THI) early warning tool
map.输入温度、相对湿度与动物类型（奶牛、肉牛、猪、蛋鸡、肉鸡、羊），计算温湿指数 T: Enter temperature, relative humidity and animal type (dairy cattle, beef cattle, pig, layer, broiler, sheep), compute the temperature-humidity index THI and give the heat stress grade and impact notes; wind speed can optionally be entered for correction, for heat prevention decisions on farms.
map.输入温度(℃)、相对湿度(%)与动物类型: Enter temperature (C), relative humidity (%) and animal type
map.计算 THI 并给出热应激等级（正常 / 警惕 / 危险等）: Compute THI and give the heat stress grade (normal / alert / danger and so on)
map.内置不同畜种的 THI 等级参考表: Built-in THI grade reference table for different livestock species
map.显示对应畜种的影响说明: Show the impact description for the selected species
map.夏季养殖：预判畜禽热应激风险: Summer farming: anticipate heat stress risk in livestock and poultry
map.防暑调度：按等级安排降温与喂料: Heat prevention scheduling: arrange cooling and feeding by grade
map.科普学习：理解温湿指数如何合成: Popular science learning: understand how the temperature-humidity index is composed
map.如有风速填选填项: If wind speed is available, fill in the optional field
map.点击「计算」得到 THI 与等级: Click 'Calculate' to get the THI and grade
map.对照等级表查看影响与建议: Check the grade table for effects and recommendations
map.THI 越高应激越重，奶牛约 72 以上进入警惕区: The higher the THI, the greater the heat stress; for dairy cows the alert zone starts at about 72.
map.高湿会放大高温危害，湿度不可忽略: High humidity amplifies the harm of high temperature; humidity cannot be ignored
map.风速可缓解热应激，填了会更准: Wind speed can relieve heat stress; filling it in gives a more accurate result
map.等级表因畜种而异，务必选对动物类型: Grade tables differ by species, so be sure to select the right animal type
map.氨气浓度与通风需求计算器: Ammonia concentration and ventilation requirement calculator
map.常用温湿指数公式由温度与湿度合成，本工具按内置公式给出数值与等级。: Common temperature-humidity index formulas combine temperature and humidity; this tool gives the value and grade using its built-in formula.
map.为什么同一种温度不同动物等级不同？: Why do different animals get different grades at the same temperature?
map.不同畜禽耐热能力不同，分级阈值按畜种分别设定。: Heat tolerance differs among livestock and poultry, so grading thresholds are set separately for each species.
